newsitem.title: UK: Cairn gains after Shell alliance news.
newsitem.headline: Cairn gains after Shell alliance news.

text.p: Shares in Cairn Energy Plc added 17-1/2 pence to 603-1/2 after the junior oil exploration firm said it was to form an alliance to combine its Bangladesh activities with giant Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
The link with Shell marks a major step in the successful development of the massive Sangu gas field offshore Bangladesh after Cairn discovered it last year, market makers said.
The field is estimated to have proven and probable reserves in excess of 800 billion cubic feet.
Cairn's shares initially peaked at 625 pence, but lost some of their momentum later on as an analysts' meeting with Cairn continued, market makers said.
Shares in Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc, the British arm of the Shell Group, eased 1/2 a penny to 1,067 pence.
